keyEvents.text: Goal! Cheltenham Town 1, FC Halifax Town 0. Jake Evans (Cheltenham Town) left footed shot from the right side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Kirsten Otchere following a set piece situation.
Jake Evans (Cheltenham Town) is shown the yellow card.
Raheem Conte (FC Halifax Town) is shown the yellow card.
Amari Morgan-Smith (FC Halifax Town) Substitution at 75'
Cruz Allen (FC Halifax Town) Substitution at 84'
Zak Gilsenan (FC Halifax Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
David Kawa (FC Halifax Town) Substitution at 90'
Owen Bray (FC Halifax Town) Substitution at 90'
Goal! Cheltenham Town 2, FC Halifax Town 0. George Miller (Cheltenham Town) header from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Charlie McCann following a corner.
